notice: Platforms A/B/C/D are same-host resource-budget emulations in this project, not official physical target-platform measurements. The latest consolidated QFF Challenge Kit defines the PQC comparison as A/B/C plus a custom D; numeric budgets here are transparent participant-proposed proxies because complete P2-specific numeric limits were not supplied in the PDFs reviewed.

profiles.name: Platform A - resource-rich baseline (local host)
profiles.note: Scans all eligible supported files on the current host. This is the resource-rich reference profile, not an independent physical-platform measurement.

profiles.name: Platform B - constrained service budget (emulated)
profiles.note: Scans at most 50 eligible files, each no larger than 64 KiB. This is a same-host scan-budget proxy, not a physical single-core or RAM-limited machine.

profiles.name: Platform C - embedded IoT scan-budget proxy (emulated)
profiles.note: Proposed embedded/IoT-style input-budget proxy: at most 10 eligible files, each no larger than 64 KiB. This is not an ARM, QEMU, Raspberry Pi or other physical-device measurement.

profiles.name: Platform D - custom bounded scan budget (emulated)
profiles.note: Custom trade-off profile: scans at most 20 eligible files, each no larger than 16 KiB. The chosen budget is between the B and C file-count limits; it demonstrates coverage/runtime trade-offs on the same host and does not enforce a RAM cap or represent a separate physical platform.
